changes_from_v0: Calibration budget is now 64000 GPTQ activation rows, not 64000 raw input tokens.
Exactly one calibration state per calibration task (N_state = number of calibration tasks).
Three calibration draws per arm; no draw may be dropped.
Four arms: static, fp_traj, cloq_all, cloq_novel.
The v0 evaluation set (85 tasks) is now development data, not final test data.

calibration.n_state_note: 39 retail + 18 airline calibration tasks from manifests/task_split_v0.json. Plan section 2 sets N_state to the exact size of the frozen calibration pool when it is not 40.
calibration.rows_per_context_fill: 64000 - 1122*57 = 46 contexts receive one extra row (1123), chosen by ascending (domain, task_id); total is exactly 64000
calibration.row_sampling: uniform without replacement over the valid non-padding token positions of the stored deployment context, drawn once per context with the draw seed and reused at every quantized layer
calibration.deficit_rule: a context with fewer valid positions than its quota contributes all of them; the shortfall is redistributed deterministically to the remaining contexts in ascending (domain, task_id) order, never duplicating a row
calibration.depth_stratification: fp_traj balances normalized decision depth globally at 25% per quartile across the 57 chosen states

arms.static: initial decision state x0 of every calibration task; identical states in all draws, so only the row subsample varies
arms.fp_traj: one BF16 trajectory state per calibration task, globally depth-balanced, keeping successful, failed and partial trajectories
arms.cloq_all: calibration tasks split evenly into an FP half and a Q half, stratified by domain and BF16 horizon quartile; FP-half tasks contribute their BF16 state, Q-half tasks contribute a uniformly depth-sampled Q0 state
arms.cloq_novel: same draw, same FP/Q task split and same FP-half states as cloq_all; each Q-half task contributes its highest-novelty post-divergence Q0 state, falling back to the highest-novelty state of the whole trajectory when the task never diverges

novelty.definition: nu(x) = min over z in the draw-matched fp_traj calibration support of (1 - cosine(phi(x), phi(z)))
novelty.representation: frozen BF16 final-layer hidden state at the action-generation boundary (the last prompt token), identical to the v0 primary occupancy representation
novelty.support: the 57 fp_traj states of the same draw
novelty.post_divergence_rule: a Q0 decision is post-divergence when its index is at or after the first decision whose context differs from the paired BF16 trajectory (t_context in cloq.divergence)

evaluation.dev_set: manifests/eval_tasks_v0.json (58 retail + 27 airline), reclassified as development data
evaluation.final_test: PENDING: retail and airline hold no unused eligible tasks, so a fresh set must come from an untouched tau2 domain (telecom) or a second benchmark; decided before Stage 6 and never after seeing v1 dev results
evaluation.long_horizon_note: frozen from v0 (BF16 horizon > 11); must not move after seeing v1 results

bootstrap.scheme: crossed: resample calibration draw, then resample tasks within draw stratified by domain

select_cloq_novel_if: mean long-task success across the three draws exceeds cloq_all
and pooled mean success is not worse than cloq_all by more than 0.02 absolute
method_selection_rule.tie_rule: if the long-task means differ by less than 0.01 absolute, choose the simpler cloq_all
